subject: gk
question:
Select the correct arrangement of the taxonomic hierarchy in ascending order from the following. 

a. Genus → Species→ Family → Order → Class → Phylum → Kingdom

b. Genus → Species → Family → Class → Order →Phylum → Kingdom

c. Species → Genus → Family → Order → Class → Phylum → Kingdom

d. Species → Genus → Family → Order → Phylum → Class → Kingdom
solution:
The correct answer is __**c**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Species:**

 
 
• The most specific and fundamental unit of classification.
 
• Represents a group of individuals that can interbreed and produce fertile offspring.
 
• For instance, Homo sapiens is the species name for modern humans.
 
• There are an estimated 8.7 million species on Earth, though only a fraction have been identified.
 
• Species can be further categorized into subspecies, varieties, or breeds.
